messages.text: What are the most important signal generation capabilities for applications in Semiconductor?

No RAW passage explicitly states semiconductor-specific applications; the supported signal-generator capabilities to prioritize are waveform-file generation/playback, supported frequency range, maximum signal bandwidth, ARB memory size, maximum sample clock rate, and—where GNSS signals are relevant—maximum GNSS channel count depending on installed baseband hardware.[26][28]
